en: Trial expiry is now a hard gate: scanning, analysis, cleanup, optimization, uninstall and login-item changes are all locked until a license is activated
Any locked action opens an activation guide that jumps straight to the license page instead of failing silently
Overview keeps showing disk usage, but every actionable feature now requires an activated license
CLI ships as 0.4.3 for version alignment; no command-line behaviour changes
zh: 试用到期改为硬门禁：扫描、分析、清理、优化、卸载、登录项改动全部锁定，必须激活 License Key
点到被锁定的功能会弹出激活引导，一键跳到授权页，不再静默失败
概览页仍显示磁盘占用，但所有可执行功能都需要激活后才能使用
CLI 同步至 0.4.3，仅为版本对齐，命令行行为无变更
